items.raw_excerpt: Portuguese student Lua Afonso has been recognised in the United States with the Anita Gale Visionary Leadership Award, following her participation in the International Space Settlement Design Competition.

items.summary_en: A company called Hanking Gold is restarting the Mount Bundy mine south of Darwin. The price of gold is very high now, so people expect the mine to make a profit in its first year.

items.raw_excerpt: Just over 13 percent of all properties sold in the second quarter of this year changed hands for less than the seller paid for them, and the number tops 20 percent in Auckland.
items.summary_en: In the second quarter of this year, about 13 percent of homes in New Zealand sold for less than the owner paid. In Auckland, that number is over 20 percent. Many sellers are losing money on their houses.

items.summary_en: A new sociocultural project brings the great experience of its workshop instructors to an ideal structure for training young people in Curitiba. The project now offers free workshops across the city.

items.raw_excerpt: The chairman of one of the Harrogate district’s oldest sporting institutions which has seen successive generations of the same families playing at the club has talked about its 180th anniversary and the key to its longevity.
items.summary_en: A cricket club in the Harrogate district is celebrating its 180th anniversary. The chairman says families have played there for several generations. He shared the club's secret to staying alive in hard times for village cricket.
items.summary_ko: 하러게이트 지역의 한 크리켓 클럽이 창립 180주년을 맞았다. 회장은 여러 세대에 걸쳐 같은 가족들이 이 클럽에서 뛰어왔다고 말했다. 그는 촌락 크리켓이 어려운 시절을 겪는 가운데 이 클럽이 오래 버틸 수 있었던 비결을 소개했다.
items.title_en: Old Yorkshire cricket club celebrates 180 years

items.raw_excerpt: Normal life is unlikely to be affected on Thursday (August 13) despite the call for a bandh called by Kannada activist Vatal Nagaraj against the directive to release Cauvery water to Tamil Nadu, as most organisations have extended only moral support to the call.
items.summary_en: A Kannada activist called for a bandh in Karnataka on Thursday against an order to release Cauvery river water to Tamil Nadu. Most organizations gave only moral support to the strike. Normal life is unlikely to be affected.

items.raw_excerpt: Supercars and Triple Eight Race Engineering have both responded after the revelation that 2024 champion Will Brown has been driving with an engine airflow restrictor that is one millimetre undersized all season.
items.summary_en: Supercars champion Will Brown raced the whole season with an engine airflow part that was one millimetre too small. The mistake made his car slower without anyone noticing. Supercars and his team have now responded after the error was revealed.
